fact: ARTCI and Togo's regulator signed an operational ECOWAS roaming protocol on 6 December 2023, after Burkina Faso and Mali protocols, following the opening of community roaming with Ghana on 15 May 2023.
title: Mise en œuvre du roaming communautaire : Signature d'un protocole d'accord entre la Côte d'Ivoire et le Togo à Abidjan
